title: Trim duplicated fixtures in split DiffPanel and AgentSessionPanel suites
outcome: Consolidated Claude7436 follow-up to tm-ownn and tm-5sou. Newly split UI suites copied roughly 290-line DiffPanel and 390-line AgentSessionPanel preambles including unused helpers. Remove unused copies and extract only genuinely reused fixture builders into small support modules; retain Vitest mock-hoisting semantics, suite-local state and setup/cleanup isolation. Do not create a giant mock module or alter assertions. Preserve test inventory and validate affected suites independently and together using maintained launcher when implemented. No correctness regression demonstrated; low-priority maintainability.
